name: appiary-widgets
description: appiary first-party capacitor plugin: home-screen widgets. the hard part is data, not pixels - the webview writes a data snapshot through the bridge while the app is alive, and the widget renders from shared storage while the webview is dead. android half is real (appwidget receiver + provider, self-contained library manifest merge); ios half is the staged data surface (the widgetkit extension target is the follow-up).
